question: A dealer purchased a water heater for ₹2,107. After allowing a discount of 79% on its marked price, he still gains 89%. Find the marked price of the water heater.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the ratio of **Marked Price (MP)** to **Cost Price (CP)**: MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit%) ÷ (100 − Discount%).

MP ÷ 2107 = (100 + 89) ÷ (100 − 79) = 189 ÷ 21.

MP ÷ 2107 = 9 ⇒ MP = 2107 × 9.

MP = 18963.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹18,963.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **CP = ₹2,107**, **Discount = 79%**, **Gain = 89%**.
Formulas: SP = CP × (100 + Gain%) ÷ 100 | MP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 − Discount%).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaa510dfed39c3afb001abf71451e4e8d7ded44af2434552b483b164ddf5a349.png] 
⇒ Step 1: Find **Selling Price (SP)**.
⇒ SP = 2107 × (100 + 89) ÷ 100 = 2107 × 1.89 = ₹3982.23.
⇒ Step 2: Find **Marked Price (MP)** from SP.
⇒ MP = 3982.23 × 100 ÷ (100 − 79) = 3982.23 × 100 ÷ 21.
⇒ MP = 398223 ÷ 21 = ₹18,963.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹18,963.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price**. SP = MP − Discount.

CP-MP Relation

The formula **MP/CP = (100 + P%)/(100 − D%)** is derived by equating SP = CP(1+P/100) and SP = MP(1−D/100).
